estimator: mean over fixed paired-seed log scores, conditional on S1
event_uncertainty_scope: Conditional on fitted models, fixed launched design and simulation settings. Includes eligible-rate and eligible-mixture variation within that design. Excludes retraining, optimizer-seed sampling, generator-setting uncertainty, and unmodeled dependence within a random-number stream.
interval_method: pointwise percentile; simultaneous centered max-|t| with bootstrap-SD denominator
multiplicity_scope: Global family covers every supplied planned contrast. Group bands cover one primary's strata and separately all primary-by-stratum effects. These are separate families, not joint coverage across catalogs or diagnostics.
resampling: exact multinomial within fixed launched strata; shared eligible weights and merged S0 atom
